hero_lede_default: Built on a flat-file foundation, designed for clarity, shipped without a database. Every page, every article, every project — written once, served fast, owned entirely.
manifesto_title: Authority, policy, and evidence — end to end.
manifesto_body: A site should not depend on a database, a build pipeline, or a stack you do not control. The CMS is a single coherent layer: content, theme, and presentation, governed by your editorial intent and nothing else.
cap_one_body: Content lives in flat JSON files. No database to provision, back up, or migrate. The filesystem is the source of truth.
cap_two_body: Every visible string passes through the i18n layer. Every layout decision lives in the theme. Every output is shaped by your code, not a vendor.
cap_three_body: Lightweight indexes, OPcache-friendly lang caches, lazy-loaded images, and zero JavaScript dependencies on the critical path.
cta_corporate_sub: Get in touch and we will get back within one business day.
contact_form_sub: Tell us what you have in mind. We typically reply within one business day.
